Run all Section 5 aggregate (school and district) analyses

Source: R/run_aggregate_analysis.R
run_aggregate_analysis.Rd

Orchestrates the five sub-analyses that can run from student_results_long alone. Sub-analyses that require school_results_long (accountability grade distributions, intervention analysis, outlier characterization by co-op or locale) are set to NULL with explanatory comments.

Usage

run_aggregate_analysis(
  student_results_long,
  assessment_spec,
  school_results_long = NULL,
  report_years = NULL,
  min_n_school = 10,
  min_n_subgroup = 10,
  improvement_threshold = 3,
  outlier_sd_threshold = 2,
  outlier_n_funnel = 20,
  correlation_flag_threshold = 0.85
)

Arguments

student_results_long

A long-format student results data frame (see data contract). Must contain school and district identifier columns.

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program.

school_results_long

Optional school-level data frame containing accountability grades, indicator scores, HQIM_FLAG, LITERACY_COACH_FLAG, CO_OP, LOCALE, etc. Default NULL. Currently unused — pass it when the data becomes available to enable sub-analyses 5.2 and 5.7.

report_years

Integer vector of years to include. NULL uses all years in the data. Default NULL.

min_n_school

Integer. Minimum students per school × year × subject × grade cell. Default 10.

min_n_subgroup

Integer. Minimum subgroup size for disaggregated analyses. Default 10.

improvement_threshold

Numeric. Percentage-point change to classify a school as improving or declining. Default 3.

outlier_sd_threshold

Numeric. SD threshold for residual-based outlier flagging. Default 2.

outlier_n_funnel

Integer. Minimum n for funnel plot inclusion. Default 20.

correlation_flag_threshold

Numeric. Spearman r threshold for flagging unstable year-to-year correlations. Default 0.85.

Value

A named list aggregate_results with sub-lists:

  • $performance_trends — compute_performance_trends()

  • $accountability — NULL (requires school_results_long)

  • $population_shifts — compute_population_shifts()

  • $outliers — compute_outlier_schools()

  • $disaggregated — compute_school_disaggregated()

  • $stability — compute_stability_analysis()

  • $intervention — NULL (requires school_results_long)

  • $params — run parameters

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
aggregate_results <- run_aggregate_analysis(
  student_results_long = demo_data,
  assessment_spec      = assessment_spec
)
aggregate_results$performance_trends$improvement_classification
aggregate_results$outliers$positive_outlier_schools
} # }
